name: harness-os
description: An OS-shaped harness for long-horizon deliverables: durable state, isolated parallel jobs, contracts written before the work, physical verification before anything is called done, and an evidence-driven repair loop with a regression gate. Domain profiles for web systems, grant proposals, EEG/HRV method work, PDF corpora, academic writing, and clinical cognitive apps. v2.1.0 adds invariant constraints that survive context compaction, dynamic challenge-response verification against reward-hacking, and a graded capability ladder.
